categories.name: AI medical & healthcare tools
categories.description: Explore clinical documentation, evidence search, and medical imaging workflows.
categories.question: What should I check before choosing healthcare AI?
categories.answer: Check the intended users, clinical purpose, applicable authorization, evidence, integrations, and patient-data protections. Evaluate with qualified healthcare professionals using an approved workflow.

categories.name: AI legal tools
categories.description: Research law, review contracts, and draft legal work with source-linked AI tools.
categories.question: How do I evaluate legal AI tools?
categories.answer: Use representative documents and jurisdiction-specific questions. Verify source citations, currency, confidentiality, review controls, and export quality with a qualified legal professional.

categories.name: AI security & guardrails
categories.description: Test model and agent vulnerabilities, access boundaries, and application safeguards.
categories.question: How should I test an AI security tool?
categories.answer: Use a bounded test environment and representative inputs. Check supported models, coverage, false positives, permissions, logging, and how findings enter your remediation workflow.

categories.name: AI 3D & spatial design
categories.description: Create and work with 3D assets and spatial design using AI.
categories.question: How do I compare AI 3D tools?
categories.answer: Start with the asset and export format your workflow needs. Inspect geometry, textures, editability, usage rights, generation limits, and downstream compatibility with the same brief.

categories.name: AI education & tutoring
categories.description: Explore tutoring, study aids, teaching preparation, and learning workflows.
categories.question: How do I choose an AI study tool?
categories.answer: Choose a tool for the learning task and age group. Test explanations, source accuracy, feedback quality, accessibility, data settings, and how it supports active learning.

categories.name: AI translation & languages
categories.description: Translate and adapt text, documents, and other language workflows with AI.
categories.question: What matters when evaluating AI translation?
categories.answer: Test real material in your language pair. Review terminology, context, formatting, confidentiality, and export quality; sensitive or consequential translations need qualified review.

categories.name: AI finance & accounting tools
categories.description: Explore financial research, accounting support, and finance operations using AI.
categories.question: How do I compare AI finance tools?
categories.answer: Separate research, accounting, and operational needs. Check source provenance, assumptions, permissions, auditability, data privacy, integrations, and the review required for your workflow.

categories.name: Healthcare practice software
categories.description: Coordinate appointments, records, and healthcare practice operations.
categories.question: How do I compare healthcare practice software?
categories.answer: Map appointment, record, billing, and staff workflows. Verify access controls, data handling, applicable requirements, integrations, migration support, and the costs of your required modules.

categories.name: Logistics & inventory tools
categories.description: Manage inventory, assets, deliveries, and operational information.
categories.question: How do I choose inventory or logistics software?
categories.answer: Test the way your team receives, tracks, moves, and reconciles items. Compare locations, integrations, permissions, export options, exception handling, and deployment requirements.

categories.name: Personal finance & budgeting
categories.description: Track household spending, budgets, and personal financial records.
categories.question: How do I choose a personal budgeting app?
categories.answer: Compare manual entry and account connections, categorization, recurring transactions, privacy, export, and supported currencies. Test with a normal month before committing to a plan.

categories.name: Bookmarking & read-later tools
categories.description: Save, organize, and find useful links and reading material.
categories.question: How do I compare bookmarking tools?
categories.answer: Test saving from your usual devices, tagging, full-text search, offline access, sharing, and export. Check whether saved copies and highlights remain accessible after cancellation.
